plan.subject: LLM agents

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model agent" OR "generative agent") AND (architecture OR framework OR pipeline OR "system design")
queries.rationale: Captures papers introducing foundational frameworks and system designs for building agents, appealing to a software engineer.

queries.query: ("tool use" OR "function calling" OR "tool calling" OR "API integration" OR "external tools") AND ("LLM" OR "language model" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Targets the critical engineering mechanism of connecting language models to external APIs and execution environments.

queries.query: ("task decomposition" OR "hierarchical planning" OR "chain of thought" OR "tree of thoughts" OR ReAct) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent")
queries.rationale: Focuses on how agents break down complex tasks and plan steps, a core capability for practical agentic workflows.

queries.query: ("multi-agent system" OR "agent collaboration" OR "agent communication" OR "role-playing" OR "multi-agent framework") AND ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Finds research on orchestrating multiple LLMs to work together, a highly active area for complex software projects.

queries.query: ("episodic memory" OR "long-term memory" OR "working memory" OR "vector store" OR "context window") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent")
queries.rationale: Captures techniques for maintaining state and context across long agent sessions, a major engineering hurdle.

queries.query: ("code generation" OR "automated debugging" OR "repository-level" OR "pull request" OR "software engineering") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "AI programmer")
queries.rationale: Directly targets agents built for coding and repository management, matching the reader's professional domain.

queries.query: ("SWE-bench" OR "AgentBench" OR "WebArena" OR "ALFWorld" OR "agent evaluation" OR "evaluation framework") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Tracks how the industry measures agent performance, helping the reader understand which architectures actually work.

queries.query: ("web navigation" OR "web agent" OR "browser agent" OR "GUI agent" OR "UI automation") AND ("LLM" OR "language model" OR "vision-language model" OR VLM)
queries.rationale: Covers agents that interact with graphical interfaces and browsers, a rapidly growing practical application.

queries.query: ("retrieval-augmented generation" OR RAG OR "knowledge graph" OR "tool retrieval") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Explores the intersection of retrieval systems and autonomous agents, essential for grounding agents in private data.

queries.query: ("self-correction" OR "self-reflection" OR "self-refine" OR "self-debug" OR reflexion) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent")
queries.rationale: Identifies methods where agents critique and fix their own outputs, improving reliability in production systems.

queries.query: ("inference latency" OR "token generation" OR quantization OR "KV cache" OR "prompt compression") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "agent framework")
queries.rationale: Addresses the practical software engineering constraints of running agents, such as cost, speed, and memory overhead.

queries.query: ("prompt injection" OR jailbreak OR "prompt extraction" OR "agent security" OR guardrails) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Highlights safety and security vulnerabilities specific to autonomous agents executing actions.

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model agent") AND (implementation OR deployment OR application OR "case study")
queries.rationale: A broad recall-safety query to catch applied engineering papers that might not use specific module buzzwords.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan heavily utilizes Pattern B, crossing specific agent capabilities (memory, tools, planning, multi-agent) with core LLM/agent terminology. It deliberately skips pure theoretical work on transformer math or non-LLM reinforcement learning, focusing entirely on modular components a software engineer would implement. The inclusion of evaluation benchmarks, UI automation, and latency/security constraints ensures the digest remains grounded in practical deployment realities.
